roleNote: An example of what you can build from kit components. Start from it, change it, or ignore it; layout is your choice. Follow `must` (kit look and accessibility); `defaults` are this example's suggestions, change any of them.
copyNote: Not exported from agentic-ds-kit. add copies the source into your app (components/patterns/assistant-start/) with this contract beside it, and the app-shell example it renders into components/patterns/app-shell/ (kept if you already have it). You own the copies: pass your nav through shell, replace the greeting, figures, prompts and apps, wire onSend, onReconnect and onAsk, and keep the `must` lines.
intent: An assistant's start page inside the app-shell example (flat): SideNav when wide, the nav in a kit Drawer from a top bar below --grid-breakpoint-md. In main, one centred column at --grid-width-sm: kit Chat embedded in its guided empty state (greeting, an intro that carries the key figures as text, suggested prompts as LinkList rows that send, the composer with the one solid Send), then a Connected apps Card (Ask in the header) with a ListView of the sources answers use, each status a Badge word and Reconnect as the row's action. Loading uses Chat loading and Skeleton rows; a failed reconnect says what answers skip. After the first send the thread fills the page.
useWhen: The landing page of an in-app assistant that answers from the workspace's data
An assistant start page that should show which sources answers come from and which need attention
doNotUseWhen: An assistant beside a working page — use Chat in the app-shell work panel or a Drawer
Managing integrations in depth — start from integration-settings
must: Use kit components from agentic-ds-kit for anything the kit has; no local cousins (composers, prompt chips, app rows, status pills)
Semantic tokens only (agentic-ds-kit/tokens.css); no raw hex, no primitive --color-* ramps
At most one appearance="solid" mode="primary" Button per view: Chat's Send
Do not restyle kit components; change them through their props, slots, and tokens
Render the page content inside a main landmark; SideNav is the nav landmark when wide and sits in a kit Drawer, opened by a named Menu Button, when narrow
The assistant is one kit Chat with embedded; suggestions are ChatSuggestion objects (LinkList rows that send), not a local grid of buttons
Each app's status is a Badge word, never colour alone; a failed reconnect says in words what answers skip
While data loads, pass Chat loading and put aria-busy on the Card with Skeleton rows
defaults: Demo is Northwind's billing assistant for Maya Chen: October MRR, overdue invoices, four prompts with icons and hints
Connected apps: Stripe (Connected) and QuickBooks (Sign-in expired, Reconnect)
Card size sm with Ask (outline neutral, MessageCircle) as its header action
Below --grid-breakpoint-md the column keeps the 24 inset and the app rows are ListView size lg
